indicator.title: Exporte von Gütern und Dienstleistungen
indicator.description: Exporte von Gütern und Dienstleistungen zu laufenden Preisen in US-Dollar.

source.indicatorName: Exports of goods and services (current US$)
source.sourceNote: Exports of goods includes changes in the economic ownership of goods from residents of the compiling economy to non-residents, irrespective of physical movement of goods across national borders. Exports of services includes services provided by residents to non-residents. This indicator is expressed in current prices, meaning no adjustment has been made to account for price changes over time. This indicator is expressed in United States dollars.
